typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblXVADailyStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Source System} as string,
		{XVATrade ID} as string,
		{Trade ID} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{WCIS ID} as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		{NettingGroup ID} as string,
		{Agreetment ID} as string,
		{Cpty HazardCurve Code} as string,
		Tenor as string,
		Input as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp())),
		Filename = toString(($sFilename))) ~> LoadDateFilename
LoadDateFilename,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(LoadDateFilename@Filename == LookupLKPTABLE@filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		AgreementID as string,
		TradeID as string,
		ProductType as string,
		Filename as string,
		Tenor as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		Input as string,
		XVATradeaID as string,
		NettingGroupID as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		CptyHazardCurveCode as string,
		WCISID as string,
		SourceSystem as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		AgreementID = {Agreetment ID},
		TradeID = {Trade ID},
		ProductType = {Product Type},
		Filename,
		Tenor,
		CounterParty,
		Input,
		XVATradeaID = {XVATrade ID},
		NettingGroupID = {NettingGroup ID},
		Loaddate = LoadDate,
		CptyHazardCurveCode = {Cpty HazardCurve Code},
		WCISID = {WCIS ID},
		SourceSystem = {Source System}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblXVADailyStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblXVADailyStaging
